reuse.why: Threads the flag into the existing getMonthActionCategories selection used by setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the average actions, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hidden check and does not get the option.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is toggled in one SQL helper; the only repetition is the identical optional-parameter plumbing in each action signature, plus the untouched parallel hidden filter in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The selection change lives in the shared category-selection query in budget/actions.ts where the exclusion rules already live.

scope.why: Focused on the actions and a test, with some unrelated prettier reformatting of existing test lines.

maintainability.why: The interpolated '1 = 1' SQL ternary is workable but awkward, and the month-wide copyPreviousMonth action is left without the flag, so the hidden rule still lives in two places with inconsistent support.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All touched actions go through getMonthActionCategories; copyPreviousMonth's own hidden filter is pre-existing and simply left untouched.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the change parameterises the existing helper.
